\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{বিনোদন} (binodôn)}{বিনোদন (binodôn)}]{\bn{বিনোদন} (binodôn) — entertainment}

\label{lesson:BN-C516-binodon}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for leftover from a meal, then the Bengali for to rinse after a meal.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{বিনোদন}}
\textbf{\bn{বিনোদন}} — \emph{binodôn} — \textquotedblleft{}entertainment\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমার} \bn{বিনোদন} \bn{বই} \bn{পড়া।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Āmār binodôn bôi pôṛā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Reading books is my entertainment.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{বিনোদন}} (\emph{binodôn}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{vinodana}, \textquotedblleft{}diversion, pastime\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{binodôn}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Āmār binodôn bôi pôṛā.} — Reading books is my entertainment.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for leftover from a meal, then the Bengali for to rinse after a meal, then say \emph{binodôn} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{ফুরসত} (phursôt)}{ফুরসত (phursôt)}]{\bn{ফুরসত} (phursôt) — spare time; a free moment}

\label{lesson:BN-C516-phursot}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to rinse after a meal, then the Bengali for entertainment.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{ফুরসত}}
\textbf{\bn{ফুরসত}} — \emph{phursôt} — \textquotedblleft{}spare time; a free moment\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{এই} \bn{সপ্তাহে} \bn{আমার} \bn{ফুরসত} \bn{নেই।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Ei sôptāhe āmār phursôt nei.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I have no spare time this week.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{ফুরসত}} (\emph{phursôt}) is usually traced to Arabic \emph{furṣa}, \textquotedblleft{}an opportunity\textquotedblright{}, through Persian \emph{furṣat}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{সাইক্লিং} (sāikling)}{সাইক্লিং (sāikling)}]{\bn{সাইক্লিং} (sāikling) — cycling (as a pastime)}

\label{lesson:BN-C516-saikling}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for entertainment, then the Bengali for spare time.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{সাইক্লিং}}
\textbf{\bn{সাইক্লিং}} — \emph{sāikling} — \textquotedblleft{}cycling (as a pastime)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{ছুটির} \bn{দিনে} \bn{আমি} \bn{বন্ধুদের} \bn{সঙ্গে} \bn{সাইক্লিং} \bn{করি।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Chhuṭir dine āmi bôndhuder sôngge sāikling kôri.}

\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{সাইক্লিং}} (\emph{sāikling}) is borrowed from English \emph{cycling}.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{মগ্ন} (môgnô)}{মগ্ন (môgnô)}]{\bn{মগ্ন} (môgnô) — absorbed (in something)}

\label{lesson:BN-C516-mogno}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for spare time, then the Bengali for cycling.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{মগ্ন}}
\textbf{\bn{মগ্ন}} — \emph{môgnô} — \textquotedblleft{}absorbed (in something)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{মেয়েটা} \bn{গল্পের} \bn{বইয়ে} \bn{মগ্ন} \bn{ছিল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Meyeṭā gôlper bôiye môgnô chhilô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The girl was absorbed in a storybook.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{মগ্ন}} (\emph{môgnô}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{magna}, \textquotedblleft{}sunk, plunged\textquotedblright{}, from \emph{majj}, \textquotedblleft{}to sink\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams): sunk deep in what you are doing.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{môgnô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Meyeṭā gôlper bôiye môgnô chhilô.} — The girl was absorbed in a storybook.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for spare time, then the Bengali for cycling, then say \emph{môgnô} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{শৌখিন} (shoukhin)}{শৌখিন (shoukhin)}]{\bn{শৌখিন} (shoukhin) — keen on a pastime; amateur}

\label{lesson:BN-C516-shoukhin}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for cycling, then the Bengali for absorbed.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{শৌখিন}}
\textbf{\bn{শৌখিন}} — \emph{shoukhin} — \textquotedblleft{}keen on a pastime; amateur\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমার} \bn{কাকা} \bn{একজন} \bn{শৌখিন} \bn{গায়ক।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Āmār kākā ekjôn shoukhin gāyôk.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My uncle is an amateur singer.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{শৌখিন}} (\emph{shoukhin}) is usually traced to Arabic \emph{shawq}, \textquotedblleft{}eagerness, longing\textquotedblright{}, through Persian; \bn{শখ}, a hobby, belongs to the same family.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}
